This blog uses the [@astrojs/mdx](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/integrations-guide/mdx/) integration, configured in `astro.config.mjs`.

## Why MDX?

MDX is a flavor of Markdown that supports JSX syntax, so you can [mix UI components into your Markdown content](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/integrations-guide/mdx/#mdx-in-astro).

## Example

This is an Astro component imported and used inside MDX. It renders as static HTML, with no JavaScript:
